name: athria-athlete-profile
purpose: Onboard an athlete and maintain confirmed personal facts, training constraints, preferences, goals, and dated wellness data.
appliesWhen: The user is setting up Athria or asks to change personal information, goals, schedule, equipment, restrictions, preferences, race dates, weight, or wellness.
doesNotApplyWhen: The user asks to rewrite the Current Mesocycle or change a specific planned workout.
safetyRules: Never infer or silently change athlete or wellness facts.
Do not rewrite the Current Mesocycle after a Profile or Wellness change.
Use current hashes and stop on a freshness conflict.
Do not provide medical diagnosis or injury treatment.
